about: 4Paradigm is a Beijing-based enterprise AI company founded in 2014 that sells machine learning platforms such as Sage, decision-intelligence software and large model tools to banks, retailers, manufacturers and governments. It listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2023. Revenue is around 5 billion yuan from platform and solution sales. B2B enterprise software with minimal consumer brand awareness.

Mavenir is a US telecom software company based in Richardson, Texas that builds cloud-native and Open RAN network software for mobile operators, including 5G core, voice, messaging and radio, with customers such as Vodafone, Orange and Dish. Owned by Siris Capital since a 2017 take-private, it did a major debt restructuring in 2025. Founded 2005. Revenue is licences and services. B2B telecom supplier with no consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Mavenir Systems, Inc.
wiki.text: Mavenir Systems, Inc. is an American telecommunications software company, created in 2017 as a result of a three-way merger of existing companies and technologies, that develops and supplies cloud-native software to the communications service provider (CSP) market.

about: Megvii is a Beijing-based computer vision and AI company founded in 2011, known for its Face++ face recognition platform and for smart city, logistics and consumer device solutions. Customers include Chinese governments, banks and device makers. Investors included Alibaba and Ant Group. It was placed on the US Entity List in 2019 and its IPO plans stalled; it has leaned into logistics robotics and IoT. B2B AI company with little consumer awareness.

Chainguard is a US software supply chain security company based in Kirkland, Washington that sells minimal, hardened container images, libraries and tools, built on its own Wolfi Linux distribution, to enterprises and developers. Founded 2021 by former Google engineers, it has raised funding at a valuation of several billion dollars from venture investors. Revenue comes from subscriptions. B2B developer brand known in cloud security communities but not to consumers.

wiki.title: Gear case
wiki.text: A gear case, also known as a chain case or chain guard, is a protective enclosure for the bicycle's chain and sprocket assemblies. Its primary function is to protect the cyclist from being soiled or trapped in the chain rings while also protecting the chain from dirt and moisture. Gear cases may fully or partially enclose the drivetrain and sometimes incorporate an oil bath for continuous lubrication. Modern examples are usually moulded in plastic. Although they are also used by some touring bicycles as well as some chain-drive machinery, chain cases are most frequently found on utility bicycles.

about: Cybereason is a cybersecurity company offering endpoint detection and response, extended detection and response and managed threat hunting through its AI-driven platform. Headquartered in Boston with an Israeli research base in Tel Aviv, it was founded in 2012 and is backed by SoftBank and Liberty Strategic Capital; it merged with Trustwave in 2025. Customers are enterprises and managed service providers. B2B security brand with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Cybereason
wiki.text: Cybereason is an American cybersecurity technology company founded in 2012. It has offices in La Jolla, California ; London, UK ; Tel Aviv, Israel; and several others around the world.

about: Luma AI is a US generative AI company based in Palo Alto, California that develops 3D capture and video-generation models, including Dream Machine and Ray video models, for creatives, studios and enterprises. Founded 2021, it raised a 900 million dollar round in 2025 led by Humain (Saudi Arabia) with AMD participation, valuing it near 4 billion dollars. Revenue comes from subscriptions and enterprise licences. Well known in creative technology and AI circles.

wiki.title: Dream Machine (text-to-video model)
wiki.text: Dream Machine was a text-to-video model created by Luma Labs and launched in June 2024. It generates video output based on user prompts or still images. Dream Machine has been noted for its ability to realistically capture motion, while some critics have remarked upon the lack of transparency about its training data.

about: LayerZero Labs is a blockchain infrastructure company, headquartered in Vancouver, that created the LayerZero omnichain interoperability protocol, which lets applications send messages and tokens between blockchains. Its ZRO token launched in 2024, and it raised funding from a16z, Sequoia and others at a valuation of about 3 billion dollars. Customers are crypto developers and protocols. Founded 2021 by Bryan Pellegrino. Known in crypto circles with minimal mainstream awareness.

Wispr Flow is a San Francisco-based software startup that provides AI-powered voice dictation across apps and devices, turning speech into polished text in any text field on Mac, Windows and iOS. Founded around 2021, it has raised venture funding from investors such as Menlo Ventures. Customers are professionals and teams subscribing for a monthly fee. Growing tech-consumer brand with limited mass awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

wiki.title: Wispr Flow
wiki.text: Wispr Flow is a speech recognition and dictation software application developed by Wispr AI. It converts spoken language into text across multiple platforms, including macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android. The software integrates with system-level input fields, allowing voice input in various applications.

about: Swvl is a mass-transit mobility company headquartered in Dubai, offering an app for booking seats on shared, fixed-route buses and private rides, originally from Cairo with presence in Egypt, Pakistan, Kenya and more. It listed on Nasdaq (SWVL) through a 2022 SPAC and then sold or shut several markets while pivoting to B2B and subscription services. Founded 2017. Strong consumer brand in Egypt, but a financially stretched company.

Megazone Cloud is a South Korean cloud and digital transformation company headquartered in Seoul, a large AWS, Microsoft and Google reseller and managed services provider across Korea and Asia, with operations in Southeast Asia and the US. It is listed on the KOSDAQ. Customers are enterprises moving workloads to cloud, and revenue is resale margins and managed services. Founded 2000 as part of Megazone. B2B technology brand with low consumer awareness.

about: EliseAI is a US software company based in New York that sells conversational AI for property management and healthcare, automating leasing, tenant communications, maintenance requests and appointment scheduling for large apartment owners and health providers. Founded 2017, it raised funding at a valuation of over 2 billion dollars led by Andreessen Horowitz. Revenue comes from software subscriptions. B2B brand known to the real estate and property technology industry, not consumers.

Enveda is a US biotech company based in Boulder, Colorado, which uses machine learning and analytical chemistry to discover medicines from natural compounds found in plants, with a pipeline of small molecules for inflammatory and metabolic conditions. Founded 2019, it has raised hundreds of millions of dollars from investors including Premji Invest, Lux and Kinnevik at a valuation over 1 billion dollars. Customers would be pharmaceutical partners. Pre-revenue biotech with no consumer brand awareness.

Founded 2019 by former Joyent and Sun engineers Steve Tuck and Bryan Cantrill, it has raised funds from Eclipse, Intel Capital and USV. Customers are enterprises and government. B2B infrastructure vendor with a cult following among engineers, not consumers.

Pateo (Pateo Connect Technology) is a Shanghai-based Chinese automotive technology company providing connected-vehicle software, in-car infotainment systems and internet-of-vehicles services to automakers such as FAW, Ford and Dongfeng. Founded 2006, it has the Pateo brand for in-vehicle telematics and a developing chassis tech and AI cockpit business. Customers are car manufacturers. B2B supplier with little consumer awareness. about: Sigma Computing is a US cloud analytics and business intelligence company headquartered in San Francisco that lets business users explore and analyse data in cloud warehouses such as Snowflake and Databricks through a spreadsheet-like interface, with AI features. Customers include thousands of enterprises. Founded 2014, it has raised funds from Sutter Hill, Snowflake Ventures and Spark Capital, at a valuation reported above 1 billion dollars. Revenue is subscription software. B2B brand known in data teams.

wiki.title: Sigma (analytics company)
wiki.what: American analytics and business intelligence company
wiki.text: Sigma is an American cloud-based analytics and business intelligence company. Sigma was founded in 2014 by Jason Frantz and Rob Woollen.

about: Upstage is an AI company building large language models and document-processing AI. Its products include the Solar family of language models and Document Parse, used by enterprises to extract data from documents. Customers are mainly businesses in finance, insurance and public sector, selling through API access and enterprise licences. Founded in 2020 and run from South Korea, with a San Jose, California listing in Crunchbase. It has raised about $735 million in total funding, the latest round in October 2026. Private and B2B, with little consumer brand awareness.

It has raised about $830 million in total funding, the latest round in September 2026. Private, B2B, with little public brand awareness outside the cybersecurity community.

The aim is agents that can act in the physical and virtual worlds, with licensing and partnerships as likely revenue. Crunchbase shows about $674 million in total funding, latest September 2026. Private. B2B research brand, little public awareness.

about: Hyperscale Data, formerly Ault Alliance, is a diversified holding company that owns businesses in data centre and bitcoin mining operations, energy, lending and defence electronics, and holds investments in other companies. Based in Las Vegas, Nevada, and chaired by Milton Ault. Revenue is mixed across subsidiaries. Listed on NYSE American (GPUS). Crunchbase shows about $606 million in funding. Small-cap, with low consumer brand visibility.

Lila Sciences is a Cambridge, Massachusetts company building scientific superintelligence, combining AI models with autonomous labs ("AI science factories") to run experiments in life sciences, chemistry and materials. It emerged from Flagship Pioneering in 2025. Customers would be pharma and industrial partners via research collaborations and licensing. Crunchbase shows about $551 million in total funding, the latest in January 2026. Private. Scientific B2B brand with little public awareness.
